forecastNote: Not refit since 2026-11-03 (see delta-log 2026-11-16): forecast.ts needs a frozen solo estimate for each unit and U-120 to U-130 have none. Every build unit is merged except U-130. Refit 2026-11-03 for the demo re-plan: start Oct 30, the 43 done units at zero, U-037 and U-102 partly done, 67 Parked and Cut units dropped with the new --drop flag (PR 733), Should units included. U-119 is left out: it has no solo estimate in the frozen panel and is mostly done. Two limits: the model ignores the board's sprint order (it starts Sprint 3 units in Sprint 2), and it does not count Sprint 2's non-unit tracks (maintenance waves 3 and 4, test audit, comment cleanup, architecture drift and dead code, client islands review). So its Dec 1 is the unit work alone; the board's Sprint values, set by hand, are the plan, and board-dates --run stays off until the model honours sprint order.
